question: Can CvNA2-specific primary physiology identify a quantitative or posture-conditioned DNp15-to-head motor interface?
scope: Reuse frozen anatomy and saved descending/motor outputs. Extract only CvNA2 movement. No new upstream, body, controller, motor targets or physiology parameters.

anatomical_evidence.source: Frozen EXP-006 induced MaleCNS v1.0 graph and official mancBodyid correspondence to MANC v1.2.1; Gorko Supplementary Table 2 and Figure 4h / Supplementary Figure 10d

physiological_evidence.location: Methods pp. 9-10; Supplementary Fig. 10 and caption p. 22; model methods pp. 31-33
physiological_evidence.supports: Direct unilateral CvNA2 optogenetic activation, TH2 innervation, right-axon-standardized movement with posture dependence
physiological_evidence.does_not_measure: Identified DNp15-to-CvNA1/CvNA2 synaptic transfer, CvNA2 firing calibration or force/torque
physiological_evidence.calibration_caveat: Patch-clamp optogenetic firing calibration is CvN7-specific. The movement model fits LED gain per fly on training data; it does not calibrate DN recruitment.

physiological_evidence.location: Suver et al. 2016, abstract and Figures 2, 3, 6, 7
physiological_evidence.supports: DNHS1 visual physiology and putative neck/haltere terminal regions
physiological_evidence.does_not_measure: Identified CvNA1/CvNA2 recruitment transfer. DNOVS1-associated neck dye coupling is not DNHS1-to-CvNA evidence.

physiological_evidence.location: Erginkaya et al. 2025, DNp15 identity, optic-flow physiology and MANC projections
physiological_evidence.supports: DNp15 = DNHS1; upstream and DN optic-flow processing
physiological_evidence.does_not_measure: Identified DNp15-to-CvNA1/CvNA2 gain, latency or side-dependent recruitment

physiological_evidence.location: Huston and Krapp 2009, Methods and Results
physiological_evidence.supports: Context-dependent subthreshold visual / haltere integration in Calliphora vicina neck neurons
physiological_evidence.does_not_measure: Drosophila DNp15-to-CvNA1/CvNA2. No cross-species cell or numerical calibration substitution is permitted.

source_data_access.access_limit: Two prior bounded header requests (30 s API / 25 s raw) and this run's 20 s API metadata request timed out. No MAT bytes or fitted CvNA2 coefficients obtained. Supplement-specific generation code was not identified in the supplied tree; main-Figure-4 preprocessing is not assumed for Supplementary Figure 10.
source_data_access.fallback: Lossless export of native /Im6 plot bitmap from frozen Supplementary PDF page 15, using optional pypdf 6.10.0. No resampling. Published axes determine units. Raster digitization with extraction uncertainty, not recovered raw trials.

measurement_contract.source: Gorko Supplementary Figure 10g-i; caption on p. 22

trial_structure.grand_mean: Caption-reported grand mean of flies from per-fly trial means; exact weighting code not recovered. Grey curves are not independent trials.

activation.state: Tethered flying norpA-blind flies; post hoc neuron identity

measurement_contract.coordinates: Right-axon standardization; left-axon data reflected to right. Lab-frame right-handed X/Y/Z = roll/pitch/yaw, body 40 degrees above horizontal. Axes label Euler-component angular velocities (degrees/s), although caption calls them time series of ZYX Euler angles. Do not reinterpret as body torque or axis-angle action-field coordinates.
measurement_contract.trace_center: Midpoint of first and last dark pixel in the unique run at least 3 pixels thick; isolated axis ticks / thin marks are rejected, not gap-filled. Linear interpolation to 8-ms source-frame spacing. No smoothing.
measurement_contract.extraction_protocol_correction: Initial all-dark-pixels-contiguous rule stopped at the first column because 1-pixel y-axis tick marks also intersected that column. Before any movement summary or bridge evaluation, revised to the uniquely thick grand-mean stroke. One isolated thin mark also appears at threshold 80. The provisional 16-pixel run-width cap rejected the steep rising yaw stroke (17 pixels); geometric cap increased to 24 pixels. Axis calibration, windows, target checks and model remain unchanged.
measurement_contract.uncertainty: Envelope from threshold variants, line half-thickness, one extra pixel in both coordinate axes; timing reported no finer than one 8-ms camera frame plus x-axis pixel error. List all sampling times whose maximum possible absolute delta can exceed the largest minimum possible absolute delta; frame resolution alone is not a peak-timing confidence interval. This is digitization uncertainty only, not SEM, biological CI or raw-data noise.
measurement_contract.magnitude_and_sign: Retain signed absolute velocities and baseline-subtracted velocities; summarize extrema/time, mean velocity and trapezoidal component integrals. Integrated Euler-component rates are not total quaternion rotation or torque.
measurement_contract.predeclared_target_check: Digitized right-axon grand mean has positive baseline-subtracted mean yaw and negative baseline-subtracted mean pitch over 0-296 ms, with extraction envelopes excluding zero. This checks target extraction, not a new DN-driven physiological model. No CvNA2 onset latency or full posture function is inferred from grand means.

required_for_bridge_replacement: Identified DNp15-to-CvNA recruitment with independent activation/firing units and side mapping
CvNA2-specific activation-to-movement transfer with initial pose and per-fly trial structure
Matched coordinate and state convention; held-out movement validation
calibration_contract.acceptance: Causal DN dependence, cervical-output mapping from crosswalk (not soma), CvNA2 movement tendency, deterministic output and timestep robustness are necessary. Neither a matching sign nor optogenetic grand means identify quantitative DN-to-movement strength. If recruitment or pose coefficients remain unidentified, retain the frozen bridge and record the exact calibration boundary; do not run a purported replacement.
calibration_contract.fitting: None. No parameter search, trajectory fit or body-gain adjustment.
calibration_contract.identifiability_witness: q_LED = K_pose * b_LED * u_LED and q_DN = K_pose * a_DN * x_DN. Even granting a known K_pose and positive recruitment, the same LED data permit a_DN = 0, 1 or 10. These illustrative dimensionless coefficients are an algebraic non-identifiability example, not fitted gains, biological bounds or simulated bridges.
calibration_contract.frozen_replay: Only saved EXP-006 descending traces are replayed through its unchanged motor model. DN disconnect/side disconnect and held-input dt-halving checks do not supply missing physiology.
